text: 16.3 1 Who's the statue of? That's Garibaldi. Garibaldi? You've never heard of him? No, I don't think so. Who was he? He was a military leader in the 19th century who helped unify Italy. He's like a national hero. He fought in South America as well. He was part of some liberation struggles in Brazil and Uruguay. Uruguay. I think his first wife was even Brazilian. I'm surprised you haven't heard of him. Well I'm not really interested in history.
